metadataRaw.title: Daily Back Pain Relief Exercise #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the clamshell and hamstring bridge using a couch.

This combination exercise is perfect to do daily to strengthen the back and help lessen future instances of pain. Also, it can also be used anytime you need quick lower back pain relief.

Let us know how it works for you!
